nodes.name: 01 Catch Watchtower error
nodes.notes: Native Error Trigger for unexpected production workflow failures. Set this under the main workflow Error workflow setting; no n8n API key is needed.

nodes.name: 02 Prepare safe error
nodes.notes: Log workflow/node/type only, never chat content, customer identity, original provider errors, credentials or stacks.

nodes.name: 03 Log Watchtower error
nodes.notes: Insert safe metadata in existing postcall_errors. Credential: Watchtower Supabase. A database logging failure still attempts the admin alert.

nodes.name: 04 Alert Watchtower admin

parameters.text: ={{ 'Marketing Data Watchtower failed.\nNode: '+$('02 Prepare safe error').first().json.failed_node+'\nReason: '+$('02 Prepare safe error').first().json.error_message }}

nodes.notes: Internal metadata-only alert. Select Watchtower Slack, set admin channel ID and invite the bot. Never send raw marketing content in this alert.
